rows: Handwritten Italian newsletters (1400s-1600s); professional news merchants; analog of Bloomberg Terminal
Lloyd's of London (insurance market); shipping intelligence sharing became mutual risk pricing
1833 (Benjamin Day, The Sun); advertising-funded, 1-cent cover price, newsboy street sales; created mass newspaper
Telegraph cost-per-word forced most-important-fact-first structure; still standard in journalism
1846 wire service cooperative; pooled telegraph costs; shared news infrastructure
Craigslist (free digital classifieds, 1995+); ~$30B newspaper revenue destroyed
Sensationalist circulation-war journalism (Pulitzer vs Hearst, 1890s); same incentive structure as clickbait
